en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 13. Ḥukaym ibn Dāwūd ibn Ḥukaym narrated to me from Salamah ibn Khaťťāb, from Ja’far ibn Bashīr, from Abān ibn ‘Uthmān, from Al-Sadūsi, from Abī ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), who said:
The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) said: On the Day of Judgment, I will intercede for those who have come to my Ziyārah.
